name: Parnok
title: Leader from the tribe of Zebulun
summary: Parnok was the father of Elizaphan, who was appointed as leader of the tribe of Zebulun. He is mentioned in connection with the distribution of the land of Canaan among the tribes of Israel. His role was tied to organizing the land allocation during the conquest of the promised land.

keyEvents.title: Parnok's son appointed as leader for Zebulun
keyEvents.description: Elizaphan, son of Parnok, was appointed as leader of the tribe of Zebulun to distribute the land of Canaan among the tribes of Israel.

keyEvents.title: God's command regarding land distribution
keyEvents.description: The Lord gave Moses instructions on who should distribute the land of Canaan, and Elizaphan son of Parnok was among the chosen leaders.

keyEvents.title: Zebulun's inheritance
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Zebulun, represented by Parnok's son, received its inheritance in the promised land according to God's plan.

keyEvents.title: Organization of the tribes
keyEvents.description: Phinehas' family was part of the larger organization of Israel's twelve tribes during the wilderness journey and preparations for entering Canaan.
